Fango 0.1 — :help for commands
> 2.5 : Float
> hi! : String
> True : Bool
> False : Bool
> Bool
> y : String
> 42
() : ()
> x : Int
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

This argument has type:

    Int

but the function expects:

    Float

1| x / 2
   ^
> -- EFFECTFUL PROMPT DECLARATION ------------------------- <repl>

Effectful declarations are not installed at the prompt; run the expression directly.

1| x = print 1
       ^^^^^^^
> -2 : Num a => a
> False : Bool
> True : Bool
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

Both sides of (&&) must be a Bool, but this one is:

    String

1| "a" && True
   ^^^
> | | | b : String
